shorts.title: Tigers in Russia Kill and Eat Brown Bears
shorts.hook: In the Russian Far East, tigers kill and eat brown bears.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Amur tigers really do hunt brown bears, but the bears steal back plenty of tiger kills; Doug's other six deaths are in the full episode.

shorts.title: Porcupine Quills Have Killed Cougars
shorts.hook: A porcupine carries thirty thousand quills, and it can't shoot one.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A porcupine can't shoot a single quill, yet its barbed quills still kill predators; watch the full episode for every animal a grizzly won't touch.

shorts.title: A Moose Boxed a Grizzly So Hard It Somersaulted
shorts.outro: Doug meets this bull, and seven other animals, in the full video below.
shorts.description: A cow moose once knocked a grizzly head over heels to save her calf, and a bull is far bigger; meet the rest in the full episode.
